environment.description: Lambda is deployed behind an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal) in VPC vpc-0a4f2c8e91b37d6f5. The ALB target group routes to Lambda via invoke permissions scoped to the ALB ARN. The ALB's security group (sg-0e7c4a912fb38d5c1) has inbound rules allowing TCP/443 only from three CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (corporate data center peered via Transit Gateway), 172.16.32.0/21 (shared services VPC peered subnet), and 10.255.0.0/24 (VPN concentrator subnet). There is no internet-facing listener, no public IP on the ALB, no NAT gateway route to the ALB subnet, and the VPC has no internet gateway attached to the ALB's subnet (subnet-0d3a7f1e82c94b6a0 in AZ us-east-1a, route table rtb-0f8c2e4a71b93d5e6 has only local and TGW routes). DNS resolution for the ALB returns only private IPs (internal-userapi-alb-1234567890.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com resolves to 10.128.4.17, 10.128.5.23). Lambda function URL is disabled. No API Gateway is deployed.
